china_opportunities.value: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026: All The Biggest Announcements, Games, And Trailers Gamescom Opening Night Live is here, and once again, it was a bumper night full of new game reveals, gameplay deep-dives, and more from Geoff Keighley's second big show of the year. There were new trailers for plenty of big games, like Gears of War: E-Day, Metro 2039, and Final Fantasy 7 Revelation. We also got a whole bunch of new reveals, and in case you missed it, you can catch up below. Worms: Galactic Tactics https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UVcmBd7u6J0&pp=ygUXV29ybXM6IEdhbGFjdGljIFRhY3RpY3M%3D Our first trailer of the preshow was for a new Worms tactics game that takes a page from the XCOM playbook. It looks like the original Worms is also coming back in some form. Train Sim World 7 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=neLLzqL_G-s&pp=ygURVHJhaW4gU2ltIFdvcmxkIDc%3D The next chapter in the long-running Train Sim World series launches on September 15. RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QWsU277r8OM&pp=ygUhUm9sbGVyIENvYXN0ZXIgVHljb29uIFdvbmRlcndvcmtz Think you have what it takes to run the ultimate theme park? You can put your skills to the test when RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks launches in early access soon. RollerCoaster Tycoon Is Back, And This Time It Has Bubsy Aniimo Aniimo looks like it might be getting a visit from The Pokemon Company soon, but until then, the new trailer for the game showed off plenty of cute critters battling each other and one titanic dragon. Genigods: Nezha https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iOgPEVTe2tk&pp=ygUPR2VuaWdvZHM6IE5lemhh An action-RPG rooted in ancient Chinese creation mythology, players will take on titanic monsters as the Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa. Perceptum https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ODzBVcJZvXM&pp=ygUJUGVyY2VwdHVt Need some horror that's all about things that go bump in the night? Perceptum looks like it'll scratch that itch when it launches in 2027. Acornia: Mirror Worlds https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a8AEhA8bQzY&pp=ygUWQWNvcm5pYTogTWlycm9yIFdvcmxkcw%3D%3D This bake-and-brawl management adventure game from Splashteam continues to look adorable, and it's out next year. Valor Mortis https://youtu.be/Y0gerXKXaWU Here's one more trailer for the upcoming first-person souls-like Valor Mortis from Ghostrunner Studio One More Level, which launches on October 13 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. TankRat https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jpdR11D1U64&pp=ygUHVGFua1JhdA%3D%3D We've got a release date for TankRat, where you'll battle swarms of corrupted mech-monsters from your heavily armed vehicle. It's out on January 17, 2027. Humankind 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1LFHvSTt880&pp=ygULSHVtYW5raW5kIDI%3D The sequel to 2021's Humankind aims to improve on the 4X strategy formula, and once again, players can guide their nation through various eras of human history. It'll be coming to PC in 2027. Humankind 2 Forces You To Deal With The Consequences Of Climate Change Murals https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHkHMcMhvjo&pp=ygULTXVyYWxzIGdhbWU%3D What do centuries-old fables like The Little Mermaid, Rapunzel, and Hansel & Gretel all have in common? Besides the original fiction being nightmare fuel, they're also all featured in Murals, an original IP from Disney Illusion Island developer Dlala Studios. The isometric action-adventure game is set across multiple famous fairy tales, and players will control a nameless hero who must brave dark, twisted takes on these beloved stories. Murals Turns Famous Fairy Tales Into A Silly Action-Adventure Age Twisters https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ao8BF1ebHfo&pp=ygUMQWdlIFR3aXN0ZXJz Age Twisters is a two-player co-op narrative adventure game, where you'll play as a grandfather and granddaughter who team up to solve puzzles. It looks adorable, but it has no release date yet. Onimusha: Way of the Sword https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jdn47UEvftg&pp=ygUaT25pbXVzaGE6IFdheSBvZiB0aGUgU3dvcmQ%3D In case you missed it, there's a demo out there for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. And if you've already played it? Then it's time to boot it up again, as Capcom has added more content to this early--and free--slice of the game. Mariachi Legends https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8FxDXI6Rb4&pp=ygUQbWFyaWFjaGkgbGVnZW5kcw%3D%3D I didn't have a Mexican vampire metroidvania on my Gamescom bingo card, but Mariachi Legends is scratching an itch for that very specific scratch I didn't know I had. It launches in April 2027. Elta: Defy All Gods https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OLEZv_Qyb6Q&pp=ygUTRWx0YTogRGVmeSBBbGwgR29kc9IHCQkTDAGHKiGM7w%3D%3D Get ready to brawl your way out of corrupted worlds in Elta: Defy All Gods. You've also got an adorable dragon-god companion, free-form melee combat, and fluid platforming, so this might be worth keeping an eye on. Nodusfall https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qf-g5aAgOGI&pp=0gcJCRMMAYcqIYzv HoYoverse made a name for itself with anime-inspired live-service games, but for its next title? It looks like the developer is taking on Elden Ring developer From Software with a high fantasy adventure that looks gorgeous. Called Nodusfall, players take on the role of a Weaver in this co-op action game. Genshin Impact Maker’s Nodusfall Sure Looks Like Multiplayer Elden Ring Rainbow Six Tactics https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iRJOXB3euJQ&pp=ygUTcmFpbmJvdyBzaXggdGFjdGljcw%3D%3D It's the first brand-new Rainbow Six game in many years! Rainbow Six Tactics features 15 unique Operators, and players will take part in missions across the globe in this XCOM-inspired title. It's out in 2027. Rainbow 6 Tactics Looks Like If Siege And XCOM: Chimera Squad Had A Baby Gears of War: E-Day https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SRFE0gCsgLg After a fun weekend in the Gears of War: E-Day multiplayer beta, the focus is on the story with this new trailer for the game. It's the darkest hour for humanity as Emergence Day leaves cities across Sera ruined, but it looks like humanity isn't ready to go down without a fight. Gears of War: E-Day launches on October 6. Gears Of War: E-Day Seems To Miss The Point Of Prequels Ananta https://youtu.be/MM60juTPkSM NetEase's free-to-play GTA-meets-Spider-Man game Ananta is all about keeping the peace and building a social media empire. It looks wonderfully ridiculous, and it launches on January 15, 2027 for PC and PS5. Ananta’s New Trailer Goes Hard On Memes Silent Hill Townfall https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JBo1W0sjt9M&pp=ygUUU2lsZW50IEhpbGwgVG93bmZhbGw%3D In case the next few months don't look busy enough, you can try out some small-town Scottish horror in Silent Hill Townfall. The new trailer showed off more of the spooky game in action, and it's the first Silent Hill to be played from a first-person perspective. It's out on September 24. Resonance: A Plague Tale https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8sHJhrFF4V0&pp=ygUYUmVzb25hbmNlOiBBIFBsYWd1ZSBUYWxl The next Plague Tale game is also out soon, and instead of having too many rats, it focuses on puzzles, exploration, and combat. You can check out the launch trailer for it above. Sea of Remnants We next got a fresh look at Sea of Remnants, a pirate-themed RPG with some stylish visuals. I can't say I'm too big a fan of the trailer's use of cheesy country music, though. Tides of Annihilation https://youtu.be/FEUjBGWiUa4 Your ears are not deceiving you! That is indeed Resident Evil Requiem's Grace Ashcroft actor, Angela Sant'Albano, taking over the role of Gwendolyn in Tides of Annihilation. The Arthurian Legend action game continues to look great, and you can wishlist it on Steam now. Lofsong Explore, listen, and unravel a hidden language buried in stone and sound: Lofsong. We still don't know much about this exploration-heavy puzzle adventure, but it has incredibly striking visuals. Mega Man: Dual Override https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uF07Tk6BhzM&pp=ygUXTWVnYSBNYW46IER1YWwgT3ZlcnJpZGU%3D It wouldn't be a Mega Man game without a few boss fights! We got our first look at one of the new bosses you'll fight, Twinkle Girl, and it looks like Proto Man is also ready to get in Mega Man's way. Wait, Is Mega Man: Dual Override Just Mega Man X Now? Rayman Legends Retold https://youtu.be/Ia1t_McxuRs Rayman speedrunning his way through a food-themed level while pasta-monsters attempt to eat him and a remix of the Macarena plays? It's good to have the limbless hero back. You can experience this for yourself when the game launches on October 1. PUBG Ded.Net https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7zh1OhGVsyo&pp=ygUMUFVCRyBEZWQuTmV0 The new PUBG game, Ded.Net, looks kind of bonkers, and I dig it. Very wild, many bullets, and it looks like Michael Bay's take on Twin Peaks. New PUBG Game Ded Net Looks Nothing Like PUBG Control Resonant https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xxby-c1R7gs It's our second game with a resonance-themed title, Control Resonant! The Control sequel looks like an action-packed blast of fun, and it launches in September for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Once Human You can grab this game for free on PC and console, starting today. Game of Thrones: War for Westeros https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T8lR38Cekd0&pp=ygUhR2FtZSBvZiBUaHJvbmVzOiBXYXIgZm9yIFdlc3Rlcm9z0gcJCRMMAYcqIYzv A proper look at the gameplay for Game of Thrones: War for Westeros confirms that maybe I'll need to use some proper tactics to take down the Night King, instead of throwing soldiers at him until he runs out of arrows and sharp swords. It comes to PC in early 2027. Game Of Thrones: War For Westeros Will Let The White Walkers Win Dust: Origins https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GVVWa41WZQs&pp=ygUMRHVzdCBPcmlnaW5z An isometric shooter from the makers of Darksiders: Genesis, developer Airship Syndicate, where you have to mow down monsters? Sign me up. The Blood Of Dawnwalker https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=huZyHs-ly44 Another game out soon, The Blood of Dawnwalker got a new story trailer ahead of its release in early September. Crimson Desert: Enhanced Edition https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5736VK42gbk It's Crimson Desert, but enhanced! This updated version of the game is out now. Exodus https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YC35xzlYrDc&pp=ygUGRXhvZHVz The new trailer for Exodus showed off more of the spiritual successor to Mass Effect. Full of dialogue choices, cover to hunker behind during firefights, and exotic powers to wield, the biggest surprise was that you can recruit a super-intelligent octopus to your team and put them inside a mechanized warsuit. The game launches on April 7, 2027. Exodus, The New Sci-Fi RPG From Former BioWare Devs, Finally Gets A Launch Date Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YrJdYlOHriU&pp=0gcJCRMMAYcqIYzv Following that sci-fi trailer, it was time for some fantasy with the first look at the gameplay for Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons. In this original single-player action-adventure, you'll play as Kaatri, a warrior who makes a fateful pact to wield dark magic against even darker powers. The game also features Maggie Robertson as Tasha, who's kind of a big deal in Dungeons & Dragons. Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons Doesn’t Seem Too Concerned With The “D&D” Part Of Its Title 1,001 Threads of Mizan https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C5gzjXwWPOg Inspired by the ancient tales of Arabian folklore, 1,001 Threads of Mizan looks like another fun fantasy game where you'll take on all manner of strange monsters. And some of them are the size of mountains, but at least you have a magic carpet that you can ride to even the odds! 1001 Threads Of Mizan Could Be The Arabian Nights Game You’ve Been Waiting For Silver Palace https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GIRhV-Pi4cA It's another anime-inspired live-service game trailer, but admittedly, the music for this new look at Silver Palace slaps , and the visuals also look pretty wild. Metro 2039 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D3HkM3AScpo Described as a game about consequence, Metro 2039's new trailer showed off an impressively bleak post-apocalyptic world. With the Nova Reich now ruling Moscow with an iron fist, it's up to the Stranger to take down Hunter, a familiar--and heroic--face from the first Metro games. The game also has a release window of February 2027. Metro 2039 Explores The Horror Humans Can Commit In Latest Gameplay Trailer Hitman: World of Assassination https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j51iu24UIjU&pp=ygURSGl0bWFuIHNub29wIGRvZ2c%3D The Doggfather, Snoop Dogg, is coming to Hitman: World of Assassination, and I'm not making this up. He'll be a free Elusive Target for Hitman players starting August 27. Aion 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FGZHZGvQNLE&pp=ygUEQWlvbg%3D%3D Time for something a little less ridiculous, as we got a new look at the MMO Aion. A new teaser that showed a lot of skin. Afterworld: Your Empire From the Ashes https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9PU1e7kfkfs&pp=ygUmQWZ0ZXJ3b3JsZDogWW91ciBFbXBpcmUgRnJvbSB0aGUgQXNoZXM%3D Paradox Interactive showed off Afterworld next, which appears to be a post-apocalyptic city-builder. That's a fresh spin on the genre, and it looks perfect for Mad Max fans thirsty for a chance to rebuild society. Petit Planet https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RTjd0hhFO74&pp=ygUMUGV0aXQgUGxhbmV0 Does HoYoverse ever sleep? The Genshin Impact studio revealed a trailer for Petit Planet, a cozy life-sim game set in a galactic world. Mewgenics I'm absolutely jealous of everyone at the Koelnmesse who got to enjoy a live performance of a Mewgenics track. The game is also coming to consoles on September 8. Alies: Fireteam Elite 2 It's in the Gamescom vents! Aliens: Fireteam 2 has just launched, and it once again pits the Colonial Marines against an army of perfect organisms--and one walking Facehugger monstrosity that gives me the shivers. 1666: Amsterdam We're still thinking that 1666: Amsterdam needs a lot of work , but that's what early access is for. The new trailer showed off more of the supernatural game in action, as well as how you can use cat scratches to control the feeble-minded. You can try it out now via Steam Early Access. Showa American Story https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iXFrZQK8kGM&pp=0gcJCRMMAYcqIYzv Showa American Story continues to be the weirdest thing around, and that's why we're keen to play this oddball action game. The new trailer showed off more gameplay and absurdity. Road Kings Have you ever wanted to drive an 18-wheeler across the US and pretend that you're taking part in a drama-free version of Smokey and the Bandit? Well, Road Kings looks like a 10-4 on that request, good buddy. You can start playing this March 11, 2027. Stage Tour https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xU-qK6FyUoM&pp=ygUKU3RhZ2UgVG91cg%3D%3D Out later this year, Stage Tour is a new game in the same vein as Guitar Hero and Rock Band. It features over 90 licensed songs, plastic instruments, and, yes, this trailer used Motley Crue's "Kickstart My Heart." The New Guitar Hero–Err, Stage Tour–Has 90+ Songs On Its Setlist And Gets A Release Date Crazy Taxi https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EjKetOGJBcQ Yeah yeah yeah yeah! Crazy Taxi is making a comeback, and Sega dropped a new trailer for the game's multiplayer mode, which looks wild . Turok Origins https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_f3btFcO1CM Considering just how packed the rest of the year is with new game releases, Turok Origins announcing a delay to Spring 2027 makes perfect sense. The Destiny-inspired game features teams of superpowered players fighting some very nasty dinosaurs. Gravhounds https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h7K6kahO2Ak&pp=ygUKR3JhdmhvdW5kcw%3D%3D Dogs with guns! It's a match made in heaven. Gravhounds looks like a mix of tower defense and third-person shooting, and it'll be out later this year. Gravhounds Reveal Trailer Sends Good Boys Into A Sci-Fi Battle Lego Skylines https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mfBg8TQQrCQ&pp=ygUNbGVnbyBza3lsaW5lcw%3D%3D A Lego city-building game, where everything just clicks into place? This Lego game is going to make a lot of money. Lego Skylines Is A Genius Idea For A Cities: Skylines Spin-Off Exterminauts You can never have too many co-op shooters where you take down hordes of nasty alien bugs, and Exterminauts looks like it'll be a nice addition to my collection of Starship Troopers-inspired games. You can wishlist it on Steam now, but there's no release date yet. Path of Exile 2 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J9o-LhAPRYY Action-RPG Path of Exile 2 releases in 1.0 on December 11. Path Of Exile 2 Is Finally Getting Its Full Release, And It’ll Be Free To Play Heroes of Might and Magic 3 remake https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yBUckLZ5QRk&pp=ygUiaGVyb2VzIG9mIG1pZ2h0IGFuZCBtYWdpYyAzIHJlbWFrZQ%3D%3D The critically acclaimed turn-based strategy game is making a comeback, and this remake will also include its two expansions. Rebuilt in full 3D and sporting 4K visuals, players can once again explore a vibrant fantasy world in this reimagined classic. No Law https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ClVyqFt1IJM&pp=ygUGTm8gTGF3 A brief look at No Law showed off a game that looks heavy on action, suspense, and cyberpunk themes. It's the work of a small Swedish developer, Neon Giant. Cyberpunk 2077’s Sequel Is Years Away, But No Law Might Fill The Gap Cinder City https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pEmI1Wh-VD4&pp=ygULY2luZGVyIGNpdHk%3D Cinder City looks like a cinematic third-person shooter set in a near-future version of Seoul that has seen better days. There's no release date yet, but the new trailer showed off some imaginative visuals. Ontos Remember Ontos? It's a sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara, and the first look at it was full of some very disturbing imagery. The new trailer didn't disappoint, as Soma developer Frictional Games' new title revealed a disturbing use for mice. Pony Island 2: Panda Circus Inscryption developer Daniel Mullins has a new game on the way, called Pony Island 2. It's described as "a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games," where you'll attempt to escape gods and keep your sanity intact. Sadly, it has no ponies. Zoopunk https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8R9bNef_ko And now for something completely different: talking animals wielding all kinds of weapons in a third-person action game. The Defiant A new first-person shooter that unfolds on the Chinese battlefields of World War II. Like or Die Billed as a team-based survival FPS where streamers clash in a fierce battle for survival, Like or Die is taking influencer culture to a new extreme. Players can also reshape the battlefield with blocks in the ultimate survival livestream. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lrxtzqI8WBY The final chapter in the Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is out in Spring 2027, and the new trailer for it showed off an epic race to stop Sephiroth from destroying the planet. With the various Weapons of the planet rising up, it looks like Cloud and friends have their work cut out for them. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Gamescom Trailer Is All About The Weapons The Witcher 3 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3SRlpX0HODY Closing out the show was The Witcher 3, which is getting a new remastered edition on September 29. It'll be a free upgrade for owners of the game, and it includes various enhancements, such as upgraded graphics, improved combat, traversal, overhauled monsters, improved skill trees, and a photo mode. It also includes the two Witcher 3 expansions, Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone, for free. We got a look at the upcoming third expansion, too. The Witcher 3 Remastered Is Adding Dozens Of Upgrades And It Might Be Free For You EA GameSpot / https://www.gamespot.com/articles/gamescom-opening-night-live-2026-all-the-biggest-announcements-games-and-trailers/

china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. However, as an ambitious manager, you see the potential for this bakery to thrive. Explore the neighborhood after the store closes: talk to neighbors and customers, assist them, and unlock their stories. You might find yourself deeply involved with the community and falling in love with this charming little bakery. input.china_demand: A pausable real-time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. Program Design Multithreaded Optimization of the Pathfinding System You will experience Establish frontline outposts to store supplies and manpower arriving from the rear. Scavenge materials in the ruins of abandoned towns, and transform existing buildings into various military and logistics facilities. Assign soldiers to logistics positions, adjust work priorities and shifts, and automate the operation of the frontline outposts. Form various combat teams to construct your own combat system. Take building clusters as tactical points, relying on solid building cover to engage in tug-of-war battles with the enemy. Arrange logistics and transportation to ensure sufficient supplies to frontline positions. Evacuate the wounded — the faster they receive treatment, the more likely they are to survive. Call for off-field artillery or airstrike support to lay the foundation for infantry assaults. Clean the battlefield and collect spoils; recover the bodies of comrades — we leave no one behind! Recover enemy armament— you may choose to repair and reuse it. Take over special locations in the city (hospitals, factories, etc.) to enhance your logistics base with existing equipment. Adjust food rations to quickly restore morale after large battles. Gather ingredients locally and grow vegetables on wasteland to ensure balanced nutrition for your soldiers. Dig trenches and stockpile supplies to prepare for enemy counterattacks. Maintain your armament to ensure it won't fail in the next battle. input.china_demand: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you… A deadly virus has broken out, and the town is swarming with zombies. Police partners, Olivenia and Noah, receive a mission to escort a Special Agent to a secret base. Noah guides her from the computer room while Olivenia fights the zombies on her own. Along the way, she uncovers information about another survivor, Beatrice, as well as a mysterious biological weapon. Will Olivenia be able to find Beatrice and survive the zombie outbreak? Or will she have a one-sided dance with the enemies while Noah may or may not be listening in the background? Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined is a rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV set in a city infected by a zombie virus. It combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting, and a deep skill system. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown, and each step taken will count towards failure or success. Rogue-lite progression Strengthen yourself by unlocking new skills after each mission. Buy new guns, upgrades, and useful items. Get stronger and defeat the enemies! Unique enemies and boss battles Dozens of strange abominations can be encountered; from zombies to mutated creatures, infested animals, living plants, weaponized machinery, and many more. Every stage features a unique selection of enemies, complete with a boss battle at the end. Defeating a stage boss will require clever use of strategy, learning the enemies' weaknesses, and utilizing the right skills at the right time. Crafting System Unlock crafting to combine items into new or stronger ones. Recovery items and ammunition for a secret weapon can be assembled whenever you are not in an active battle. Plan ahead of time to make sure you have the edge in combat when you need it the most. Encounter random events: every run is different Meet other characters, open chests with valuable loot, buy stat-altering drinks, and defeat thieving little rodents among many other events that can be encountered at random. No two runs will be the same. Utilize an arsenal of weapons and skills Unlock unique guns, each with their own benefits and downsides; use throwables to blast enemies into pieces, blind them, stun them or set them all on fire. Olivenia can also learn hundreds of different active and passive skills. Every gun has its own set of active skills, like unlocking the potential of rapid fire for the pistol, or birdshot to hit all enemies at once with the shotgun, supplemented by a huge number of passives that boost your defenses. It is a short, escalating experience about discovering synergies, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions. Take over a failing diner, master 30 recipes, manage unique staff, use 40 tools, unlock 30 secrets. 10 festivals bring challenges, 10 endings await. Easy to pick up, surprisingly deep — build your million-dollar dream! Welcome to your dream restaurant! This is a warm, pixel-art restaurant management sim where you don't just cook — you build a culinary empire from a struggling street stall to a million-dollar hotspot . Massive Content, Endless Possibilities 30 Signature Recipes : From humble fried rice and braised pork to exquisite French escargot and A5 Wagyu. Curate your menu to define your restaurant's identity and destiny. Dozens of Chefs & Waiters : Each staff member has unique traits and personalities. Hire seasoned veterans or nurture young talent — team composition is a strategic puzzle. 40 Functional Tools : From "Smart Woks" that speed up cooking to "Influencer Signage" that boosts foot traffic. Use them wisely to turn the tide in critical moments. 30 Business Secrets : Unlock strategies like "Hunger Marketing," "Cost Crunch," and "Michelin Star Hunt." A Living, Breathing World 10 Festivals & Events : Lunar New Year, Mid-Autumn Festival, Food Carnival, Halloween… Each brings unique crowds and special challenges. Seize the seasonal opportunities to maximize profits. 10 Unique Endings : Every decision alters your restaurant's fate. Will you become the neighborhood's beloved "comfort food haven," a "three-Michelin-star" fine dining icon, or… go bankrupt again? Ten endings await your discovery. Easy to Learn, Deep to Master No tedious tutorials — drag-and-drop controls and intuitive feedback get you cooking in under five minutes. But reaching that million-dollar goal requires balancing costs, staffing, reputation, and R&D — every decision tests your business acumen. china_opportunities.value: A desktop idle RPG where your party of five heroes fights, loots, and grows in a small window while you work. Tuck a small transparent window into a corner of your screen — or anywhere you like — and let your party of five heroes keep fighting, looting, and leveling while you work, code, or browse. My Party Is Grinding blends the comfort of an idle game with the depth of a classic hack-and-slash RPG, right on your desktop. You're not grinding — your party is. Lives on Your Desktop A semi-transparent window runs right alongside everything else on your screen Drag it anywhere, zoom in and out, pin it always-on-top, or click straight through it Glance over between tasks, click a dropped chest, and collect your rewards Five Heroes, One Party Knight, Warrior, Assassin, Archer, and Mage — five classes, five distinct roles Level up each class with stat points and a kit of active & passive skills — equip a loadout of up to four actives Dress every class in unlockable costumes — wearing is purely cosmetic, so mix and match freely Unlock new classes and expand your skill slots as you grow Endless Loot, Deep Gear Crafting Over 400 pieces of gear across 8 grades and 12 slots Layered enhancement with gems, engravings, and enchantments Forge, fuse, and craft at the Blacksmith; engrave, enchant, socket, and extract at the Mage Tower Stockpile the random chests that drop in battle and open them whenever you like Four Regions, 200 Battles 4 acts × 10 stages × 5 difficulties (Normal, Hard, Nightmare, Hell, Inferno) Stage bosses and powerful act bosses that hit back with their own signature skills Auto-challenge farms your current stage on repeat — and you keep earning gold & XP even while the game is closed (offline catch-up, up to 8 hours) Progression That Never Stops Orb Circuit — a sprawling directional growth tree with 200+ nodes Constellations — a second growth axis with powerful keystone bonuses Collections & Factions — completing costume gear collections grants permanent, party-wide bonuses, and owning more costumes from the same faction makes every hero stronger Pets — unlock them by slaying monsters and keep their bonuses just by owning them Automated Combat With Real Strategy Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Chaos elements, each with their own status effects A layered mitigation pipeline of dodge, block, damage reduction, and armor Downed heroes and revives, plus a live damage meter to track each hero's contribution Steam Community Market: Coming After Launch Trading your items with other players on the Steam Community Market is planned as a free post-launch update. input.china_demand: Start with an empty plot in 1930s America and build your farm from the ground up. Direct workers, organize their tasks, expand to new properties, develop vehicle logistics, and grow into an advanced wheat and flour enterprise. Start with an empty plot of land in 1930s America and build a working farm from the ground up. Lay out your fields, secure water, construct storage and trading facilities, hire your first workers, and gradually develop a complete wheat and flour enterprise. Build From Nothing There is no ready-made farm waiting for you. Begin with bare land and decide how your operation will take shape. Establish fields, build a well, add storage and a Trade Post, then expand into flour production with a mill and the transport infrastructure needed to keep everything moving. Every new building solves one problem while creating new demands for workers, supplies, space and organization. Direct Your Workers Your farm is run by people, not by invisible production numbers. Hire workers through the management menu, meet them in the game world and assign the jobs that keep the farm moving. Each worker can be given several tasks, allowing you to organize routines, set priorities and decide where their time is needed most. A well-organized workforce can keep several parts of the farm running smoothly. Poor planning can leave important jobs waiting while workers are occupied elsewhere. Workers expect to be paid at the end of each day. If the farm runs out of money, unpaid wages begin to build up—and workers who go too long without receiving their pay may eventually decide to leave. You may also dismiss workers when your plans or finances change. Keep Production Moving A successful harvest begins long before the wheat is ready. Make sure seed, fuel, fertilizer and water are available when they are needed. Balance the number of workers, available storage and transport capacity before committing to a larger production cycle. A missing delivery, an empty fuel supply or a full storage area can slow down more than one building. Grow and harvest wheat, move it into storage, and keep the mill supplied so that production can continue without unnecessary interruptions. Choose How You Sell Once the flour is ready, you decide how it enters the economy. Take on city contracts with defined quantities and obligations, or offer your goods on the open market. Contracts provide clearer targets, while market prices respond to actual supply and demand. The market is not an unlimited source of money. Selling large quantities can affect prices, future demand and the value of the next shipment. Timing, volume and the choice of buyer all matter. Expand Beyond One Farm As your business grows, new opportunities begin to open up. Bring trucks into your operation to move goods more efficiently across the farm. When you are ready to expand, purchase a nearby bankrupt property and gradually bring it back into productive use. As your network grows, Truck Posts help your farms work together by moving supplies and goods where they are needed most. Unlock More Advanced Systems Growth gives you access to new ways of organizing production. Develop irrigation networks to move water where it is needed, and unlock greater automation in flour production. As the farm expands, your role gradually changes from keeping a small operation alive to coordinating workers, vehicles, resources and production across several locations. Every Resource Has a Place Resources on your farm are not abstract values hidden behind a menu. Sacks, containers and other goods exist physically in the world. Workers and vehicles carry them between real locations, buildings have limited space, and production can use only the supplies that have actually reached the correct destination. What you see on the farm reflects what you truly own—and every successful production chain depends on how well you organize its physical flow. Pharmacy Simulator: Big Pharma is a highly detailed business management tycoon and life sim where you build your own medical retail empire. 我们希望内政不是独立于战斗之外的一串升级按钮，而是军团战略的重要组成部分。积极扩张能够获得更多资源，却会拉长防线；专注防守更加稳妥，却可能失去重要发展机会；与强大联盟合作可以降低风险，也必须考虑长期利益和局势变化。 玩家所建立的不只是一支队伍，更是一个能够持续运转的势力。那些在战场之外作出的决定，最终会在战场上得到体现。 八、随机探索，让每一次冒险都有新鲜感 除了主线、竞技和国战，我们还加入了带有Roguelike元素的秘境探索。 玩家进入古墓或秘境后，可能遇到不同路线、宝物、敌人和随机事件。有时需要在短期增益和长期收益之间进行选择，有时需要判断是否承担风险挑战强敌。天气也会动态影响战斗：雨天可能削弱火攻，大风则会增强远程攻击。 随机玩法的意义，不是让胜负完全取决于运气，而是让玩家在不确定条件下进行判断。同一套阵容、同一位主公，在不同路线和事件中也可能得到完全不同的体验。 我们会持续扩充秘境主题、事件类型、敌人机制与奖励内容，希望这部分玩法能够成为主公们日常上线时值得期待的一段冒险，而不是又一项必须完成的负担。 九、关于福利、付费与长期公平 对于一款长期运营的手游而言，付费设计是无法回避的话题。我们理解玩家对公平性的担忧，也明白“零氪能不能玩”“资源是否够用”“付费差距会不会越来越大”直接影响游戏体验。 我们的基本原则是：付费可以让成长更加高效，也可以提供更丰富的外观与便利，但不能完全剥夺普通玩家通过时间、策略和持续参与获得核心内容的机会。 签到、在线活动、离线收益、联盟宝箱、赛季任务以及免费副本，都将成为玩家获得武将、元宝、招募券和强化资源的重要途径。SSR武将不应该只存在于付费入口中，普通玩家也应当能够通过稳定积累组建有竞争力的阵容。 与此同时，我们会谨慎处理限时活动带来的压力。活动应该提供目标和惊喜，而不是让玩家因为错过一天就产生巨大的损失感。我们希望《挂机吧三国》能够适应玩家的生活，而不是要求玩家的生活围着游戏运转。 有些玩法最初看起来很有趣，实际体验却过于复杂；有些武将的技能描述很精彩，进入实战后却缺少存在感；有些界面承载了太多信息，反而让新玩家不知道应该先做什么。性能优化、网络稳定、数值平衡和引导节奏，也都经历过多轮修改。 即使游戏正式上线，我们也不敢说所有问题都已经解决。不同设备可能出现适配差异，大规模国战可能带来新的性能压力，部分玩法也可能存在体验不够顺畅的地方。 对于一款长期运营的手游而言，付费设计是无法回避的话题。我们理解玩家对公平性的担忧，也明白“零氪能不能玩”“资源是否够用”“付费差距会不会越来越大”直接影响游戏体验。 我们的基本原则是：付费可以让成长更加高效，也可以提供更丰富的外观与便利，但不能完全剥夺普通玩家通过时间、策略和持续参与获得核心内容的机会。 签到、在线活动、离线收益、联盟宝箱、赛季任务以及免费副本，都将成为玩家获得武将、元宝、招募券和强化资源的重要途径。SSR武将不应该只存在于付费入口中，普通玩家也应当能够通过稳定积累组建有竞争力的阵容。 与此同时，我们会谨慎处理限时活动带来的压力。活动应该提供目标和惊喜，而不是让玩家因为错过一天就产生巨大的损失感。我们希望《挂机吧三国》能够适应玩家的生活，而不是要求玩家的生活围着游戏运转。 在创作过程中，我们既研究过.战锤.式的大规模战争表现，也思考过.虎豹骑.在真实三国战场中的速度与冲击力。我们希望不同阵容能够形成如.tribe.般鲜明的势力特色，也希望玩家即使通过.fc.式轻量操作，也能进入充满.双影奇境.变化的策略空间。我们相信，真正吸引人的从来不是单纯的数值，而是“千军易得，.一策难求.”的临场判断。 然而，在决定制作《挂机吧三国》时，我们也反复问过自己：市面上已经有许多三国游戏，我们还能带给玩家什么？ 从.2k25.式持续成长，到.刺客信条.式目标推进，再到.人中之龙.般生动的人物塑造，不同作品都向我们展示了长线内容的可能性。我们也研究过.palworld.的伙伴体验、.stardew.式日常节奏、.limbus.式队伍组合、.帝国神话.式势力经营，以及.2077.和.gta5.所呈现的开放叙事方式。我们还尝试从.灵异.、.聊斋.、.僧.、.志怪.与.问道.等文化意象中寻找适合秘境玩法的灵感。 我们发现，很多喜爱策略游戏的玩家已经步入了学习、工作和家庭生活更加忙碌的阶段。大家仍然渴望调兵遣将、招募名将、攻城略地，但很难每天投入大量时间完成重复任务。传统放置游戏虽然轻松，却容易陷入单纯比较战力数字的循环；传统策略游戏拥有足够的深度，却可能带来较高的时间压力。 因此，不论玩家偏爱.冒险.、.动作类.、.模拟.、.角色扮演类.、.射击类.还是.竞速类.体验，我们都希望他们可以在游戏中找到容易理解的目标与适合自己的成长节奏。 于是，我们为《挂机吧三国》确立了一个看似简单、实际却很难实现的目标：让游戏既能够解放双手，也能保留真正的策略乐趣。 我们希望玩家离线时，武将依然会自动战斗、积累经验并收集资源；玩家上线之后，则不必花费大量时间重复刷图，而是能够把精力放在更有意义的决策上：今天应该培养哪位武将？该选择什么阵型？面对敌方骑兵阵容，是否需要调整兵种？联盟攻城时，是正面强攻，还是夜袭、围城、断粮？有限的资源应该投入神兵、坐骑，还是城池建设？ “放置”解决时间问题，“策略”创造游戏乐趣，这就是《挂机吧三国》诞生的初衷。 当然，这种创新需要把握尺度。我们会努力在历史气质、角色辨识度和趣味表达之间寻找平衡。无论外在风格如何变化，关羽的忠勇、赵云的果敢、诸葛亮的智慧、曹操的雄心，依然应该是角色塑造的核心。 七、城池经营，也是战争的一部分 战争从来不只是两支军队在战场上的碰撞。 粮草是否充足、城市是否坚固、技术是否先进、人才是否得到合理任用，都会影响最终胜负。因此，《挂机吧三国》加入了内政管理与城池建设系统。 玩家可以招募文官，发展农业、商业与科技，提升资源产量和部队上限；可以修建箭塔、陷阱与瓮城，增强防守能力；也可以通过外交与其他势力结盟、宣战和贸易。 我们希望内政不是独立于战斗之外的一串升级按钮，而是军团战略的重要组成部分。积极扩张能够获得更多资源，却会拉长防线；专注防守更加稳妥，却可能失去重要发展机会；与强大联盟合作可以降低风险，也必须考虑长期利益和局势变化。 玩家所建立的不只是一支队伍，更是一个能够持续运转的势力。那些在战场之外作出的决定，最终会在战场上得到体现。 八、随机探索，让每一次冒险都有新鲜感 除了主线、竞技和国战，我们还加入了带有Roguelike元素的秘境探索。 玩家进入古墓或秘境后，可能遇到不同路线、宝物、敌人和随机事件。有时需要在短期增益和长期收益之间进行选择，有时需要判断是否承担风险挑战强敌。天气也会动态影响战斗：雨天可能削弱火攻，大风则会增强远程攻击。 随机玩法的意义，不是让胜负完全取决于运气，而是让玩家在不确定条件下进行判断。同一套阵容、同一位主公，在不同路线和事件中也可能得到完全不同的体验。 我们会持续扩充秘境主题、事件类型、敌人机制与奖励内容，希望这部分玩法能够成为主公们日常上线时值得期待的一段冒险，而不是又一项必须完成的负担。 九、关于福利、付费与长期公平 对于一款长期运营的手游而言，付费设计是无法回避的话题。我们理解玩家对公平性的担忧，也明白“零氪能不能玩”“资源是否够用”“付费差距会不会越来越大”直接影响游戏体验。 我们的基本原则是：付费可以让成长更加高效，也可以提供更丰富的外观与便利，但不能完全剥夺普通玩家通过时间、策略和持续参与获得核心内容的机会。 签到、在线活动、离线收益、联盟宝箱、赛季任务以及免费副本，都将成为玩家获得武将、元宝、招募券和强化资源的重要途径。SSR武将不应该只存在于付费入口中，普通玩家也应当能够通过稳定积累组建有竞争力的阵容。 与此同时，我们会谨慎处理限时活动带来的压力。活动应该提供目标和惊喜，而不是让玩家因为错过一天就产生巨大的损失感。我们希望《挂机吧三国》能够适应玩家的生活，而不是要求玩家的生活围着游戏运转。 我们也不会假装一次设计就能解决所有平衡问题。随着版本更新、阵容开发和玩家生态变化，新的问题一定会出现。我们会持续观察资源产出、武将使用率、竞技胜率和不同付费层级的体验，并及时调整不合理的部分。 十、我们知道自己仍有不足 开发过程中，我们经历过许多并不轻松的时刻。 有些玩法最初看起来很有趣，实际体验却过于复杂；有些武将的技能描述很精彩，进入实战后却缺少存在感；有些界面承载了太多信息，反而让新玩家不知道应该先做什么。性能优化、网络稳定、数值平衡和引导节奏，也都经历过多轮修改。 即使游戏正式上线，我们也不敢说所有问题都已经解决。不同设备可能出现适配差异，大规模国战可能带来新的性能压力，部分玩法也可能存在体验不够顺畅的地方。 对于这些问题，我们不会回避。玩家提交的每一份反馈，无论是故障报告、平衡建议、操作困惑还是美术意见，都会成为后续优化的重要依据。我们会努力提高修复效率，并在版本公告中尽可能清楚地说明改了什么、为什么修改。 如果某项设计给大家带来了困扰，我们希望先理解真实原因，而不是简单地用奖励掩盖问题。补偿能够表达态度，但真正重要的是修复问题，并避免同类问题再次发生。 十一、未来，我们想和玩家一起建设这个三国世界 《挂机吧三国》的上线只是第一阶段。 未来，我们希望把这个世界写成一曲属于所有玩家的.万民长歌.。我们会通过游戏内.博物馆.式图鉴保存武将、装备与历史资料，也可能从.euro.式大战略表达、.波斯王子.式冒险节奏及.cs.式团队协作中继续学习。对于玩家关心的.永劫无间.式竞技体验、.ats.相关内容讨论、.cs2.式对抗节奏和.ets.式长期经营感，我们都会结合自身定位谨慎研究，而不是生硬照搬。 我们计划持续增加新的武将、剧情章节、秘境主题、联盟玩法与赛季内容。历史事件也会逐步扩展，让玩家经历更多经典战役，并探索不同选择所产生的分支故事。无论故事再次回到.明末.般风云激荡的时代联想，还是聚焦真正属于三国的群雄逐鹿，我们都会坚持以自身世界观和玩家体验为核心。 我们还希望增加更多适合朋友共同参与的内容。三国不应只是一场孤独的数值成长，也应当包含并肩作战、互相支援和共同庆祝胜利的时刻。无论是联盟攻城、跨服对决，还是更轻量的协作活动，我们都会继续探索。 对于喜欢研究策略的玩家，我们会提供更丰富的阵容构筑空间；对于时间有限的玩家，我们会继续优化减负功能；对于重视收集和角色故事的玩家，我们会补充更多人物剧情与互动；对于热衷竞争的玩家，我们会完善赛事体系和赛季荣誉。 我们希望不同类型的玩家都能在同一个三国世界中找到自己的位置。 也许你想成为跨服竞技的巅峰王者，也许你想带领联盟问鼎洛阳；也许你只想每天上线十分钟，看看武将又带回了多少资源；也许你喜欢研究冷门阵容，尝试用独特组合击败强敌；也许你只是喜欢三国人物，想收集他们并陪伴他们成长。 这些玩法没有高低之分。只要能从中获得快乐，你选择的道路就是有意义的。 十二、写在最后 制作游戏是一段漫长的旅程。 开发者在屏幕这一端编写规则、绘制角色、调整数值、修复问题，但当游戏真正交到玩家手中之后，它才开始拥有超越代码与图像的生命。玩家会创造我们没有预料到的阵容，制定意想不到的战术，结识新的伙伴，也会留下只属于某个服务器、某个联盟和某一群人的故事。 这些故事，才是一款游戏最珍贵的部分。 感谢大家愿意走进《挂机吧三国》的世界，感谢大家给予我们的期待，也感谢每一条批评与建议。你们的支持不会让我们停止反思，反而会提醒我们承担起更大的责任。 我们希望这是一款能够陪伴大家很久的游戏：不需要时刻紧盯屏幕，不必被重复任务拖累；忙碌时可以安心离线，归来时依然有所收获；想轻松时能够享受养成乐趣，想认真时也有足够深度值得研究。 乱世已经开启，名将正在集结，洛阳的战鼓即将响起。 愿每一位主公都能遇见自己喜爱的武将，组建独一无二的军团；愿每一次排兵布阵都有意义，每一次联盟集结都有回应；愿胜利带来荣耀，失败也能成为下一次破局的经验。 历史记住了那些熟悉的英雄，而在《挂机吧三国》中，新的故事将由你书写。 诸位主公，三国路远，我们战场上见！ ——《挂机吧三国》开发团队 Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
